evidence.snippet: Tool to create a new client contact. Use when you need to add a contact under an existing client.
Tool to create a new invoice. Use when you have gathered all invoice details and need to bill a client in Harvest.

decisions.reason: The Composio toolkit page lists 57 distinct tools spanning many separate resources (clients, contacts, estimates, estimate messages, expenses, invoices, invoice messages, invoice payments), indicating a broad API surface rather than a narrow single-purpose one.
